dialogues.speaker: Arnold
dialogues.text: Such a succulent fragrance of grapes... Ah, this place is heaven! Had I a mouth that could move, I doubt I could resist eating them right off the vine!

dialogues.speaker: Rozel
dialogues.text: Whoever lives in here must be a person of means indeed. Even in a storybook world like Simulanka, we could never afford such a big estate.

dialogues.speaker: Esnoir
dialogues.text: Wait, but this is a world inside a story too, isn't it? Oh, hello. Is something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: My apologies. But the event taking place at Dawn Winery is not open to the public quite yet. Allow me to show you around a different area.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How'd you come to be stationed here?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Miss Alice thought things might get complicated around here, so she said she needed someone capable who could get the job done.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So she... flattered her way into dumping a bunch of work on you? Stuff that isn't even related to the Knights at all?

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Oh, no no. Mr. Diluc was there too. He said he would appreciate some help guiding the tour groups from different worlds that are here to visit.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Tour groups from different worlds? Oh, right... The Golden Apple Archipelago, the Veluriyam Mirage, Simulanka... The gang's all here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She really put you to work, huh.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: It's alright. I'm happy to help!
